revenueModel.text: Patients with MASH or healthcare providers pay for Rezdiffra, an oral therapy for treating noncirrhotic MASH with moderate to advanced liver fibrosis.
revenueModel.evidence: In March 2024, Rezdiffra became the first therapy approved by the FDA for patients with MASH and was commercially available in the United States beginning in April 2024.

changes.text: In 2025, the company received conditional marketing authorization from the European Commission for Rezdiffra and launched it in Germany in September 2025.
changes.evidence: Following receipt of conditional marketing authorization ("CMA") from the European Commission ("EC"), we launched Rezdiffra in Germany in September 2025.
